description: Bookable shore excursions and resort day passes in a cruise port, with price, duration, rating and a link. Pass activity (e.g. "scuba", "ATV tours") to narrow to that kind of excursion, with its total, and minPrice/maxPrice to narrow by price. To narrow an earlier answer by price, call again with the same port and activity plus the price. For every port of one sailing, use getSailingExcursions.

activity.description: A kind of activity, e.g. "scuba", "ATV tours", "snorkeling"; omit for everything

maxPrice.description: Highest "from" price per person in US dollars, e.g. 145 for "under $145"; omit for no limit

minPrice.description: Lowest "from" price per person in US dollars, e.g. 100 for "over $100"; omit for no limit

name: getPortExcursions
title: Shore excursions
